text: «ድር ቢያብር … ያስር» ይላል የአበው ተረት። የጎደለው የእንስሳ ስም የትኛው ነው?
gloss: "When spider webs unite, they can tie up a …" — which animal? — A lion: the proverb «ድር ቢያብር አንበሳ ያስር» (unity is strength).

text: በቡና ማፍላት ሥነ ሥርዓት ቡናው የሚፈላበት፣ አንገቱ ረጅም የሆነው የሸክላ ዕቃ ምን ይባላል?
gloss: In the coffee ceremony, what is the long-necked clay pot the coffee is boiled in called? — Jebena. Sini is the cup, rekebot the tray/stand, mitad the injera griddle.

text: ዘሩ በዓለም ላይ ካሉ እህሎች ሁሉ ትንሹ ከሚባሉት አንዱ ሲሆን፣ እንጀራ በዋናነት የሚጋገረው ከዱቄቱ ነው። ይህ እህል የትኛው ነው?
gloss: Its seed is among the tiniest of all grains, and injera is mainly baked from its flour. Which grain? — Teff. Barley, sorghum and wheat are sometimes mixed in, but teff is the main one.

text: በኢትዮጵያ አቆጣጠር እያንዳንዱ ወር 30 ቀናት አሉት። ዛሬ ነሐሴ 30 ከሆነ፣ ነገ ስንት ይሆናል?
gloss: In the Ethiopian calendar every month has 30 days. If today is Nehase 30, what is tomorrow? — Pagume 1: the short 13th month comes before New Year (Meskerem 1), the autopilot trap.

text: በ1960 (እ.ኤ.አ.) በሮም ኦሊምፒክ ማራቶንን በባዶ እግሩ ሮጦ ያሸነፈው ኢትዮጵያዊ አትሌት ማን ነው?
gloss: Which Ethiopian won the 1960 Rome Olympic marathon running barefoot? — Abebe Bikila. Mamo Wolde won in 1968, Miruts Yifter on the track in 1980, Haile Gebrselassie in 1996/2000.

text: ለበዓል ሦስት ደርዘን እንቁላል የገዛ ሰው በአጠቃላይ ስንት እንቁላል ገዛ?
gloss: Someone buys three dozen eggs for a holiday. How many eggs? — 36: a dozen is 12, times 3.

text: በተለመደው ባለ ስድስት ገጽ የጨዋታ ዳይስ ላይ የተቃራኒ ገጾች ነጥቦች ሲደመሩ ሁልጊዜ 7 ይሆናሉ። ከ2 ነጥብ ተቃራኒ ያለው ገጽ ስንት ነጥብ አለው?
gloss: On a standard six-sided die, opposite faces always add up to 7. What is opposite the 2? — 5, since 2 + 5 = 7.

text: ከአፍሪካ ምሥራቃዊ ጠረፍ እስከ አውስትራሊያ ድረስ የተዘረጋው ውቅያኖስ የትኛው ነው?
gloss: Which ocean stretches from Africa's eastern coast to Australia? — The Indian Ocean.

text: በመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ታሪክ መሠረት፣ ከጥፋት ውሃ በኋላ በመንቁሩ የወይራ ቅጠል ይዞ ወደ ኖኅ መርከብ የተመለሰው ወፍ የትኛው ነው?
gloss: In the Bible, which bird came back to Noah's ark with an olive leaf in its beak after the Flood? — The dove (Genesis 8). The raven is the trap: Noah sent it out first, but it did not come back with a leaf.

text: ክንፍ ኖሮት በእውነት መብረር የሚችል ብቸኛው አጥቢ እንስሳ የትኛው ነው?
gloss: Which is the only mammal with wings that can truly fly? — The bat; the aha is that its Amharic name, "night bird", calls it a bird.

text: በኢትዮጵያ የሰዓት አቆጣጠር «ከጠዋቱ 3 ሰዓት» በዓለም አቀፉ የ24 ሰዓት አቆጣጠር ስንት ሰዓት ነው?
gloss: In Ethiopian time, "3 o'clock in the morning" is what in international 24-hour time? — 09:00: the Ethiopian day starts counting at sunrise (06:00 = 12 o'clock), so add six hours.

text: ሰላም ታክሲ ለመያዝ በተሰለፉ ሰዎች መካከል ቆማለች፤ ከፊት ስትቆጠር 4ኛ፣ ከኋላ ስትቆጠር ደግሞ 4ኛ ናት። ሰልፉ ውስጥ በአጠቃላይ ስንት ሰው አለ?
gloss: Selam stands in a taxi queue, 4th from the front and 4th from the back. How many people are in the queue? — 7: three ahead, three behind, plus Selam. 8 is the trap of counting her twice.

text: አንድ ወረቀት ለሁለት ታጥፎ፣ እንደገና ለሁለት፣ ከዚያም ለሦስተኛ ጊዜ ለሁለት ቢታጠፍ ስንት ንብርብር ይኖረዋል?
gloss: A sheet of paper is folded in half three times. How many layers does it have? — 8: each fold doubles the layers, 2 → 4 → 8.

text: የእርሳስ ጥቁሩ ልብ (ግራፋይት) እና አልማዝ የተሠሩት ከአንድ ዓይነት ንጥረ ነገር ነው። የትኛው ንጥረ ነገር ነው?
gloss: A pencil's black core (graphite) and diamond are made of the same element. Which? — Carbon. The trap: «እርሳስ» means both "pencil" and the metal lead, yet pencils contain no lead.

text: «ፍቅር እስከ መቃብር» የተሰኘውን ዝነኛ ልብ ወለድ የጻፈው ማን ነው?
gloss: Who wrote the famous novel "Love unto the Grave" (Fikir Iske Mekabir)? — Haddis Alemayehu (1965). The others are major Amharic novelists of the same era.

text: «ክብረ ነገሥት» እንደሚተርከው፣ ቀዳማዊ ምኒልክ የንግሥተ ሳባና የየትኛው ንጉሥ ልጅ ነው?
gloss: According to the Kebra Nagast, Menelik I is the son of the Queen of Sheba and which king? — Solomon. David, Solomon's father, is the trap.

text: በመስቀል በዓል የሚለኮሰው ደመራ፣ በትውፊቱ መሠረት የጢሱን አቅጣጫ ተከትላ የጌታን መስቀል ያገኘችውን ንግሥት ያስታውሳል። ይህች ንግሥት ማን ናት?
gloss: The Demera bonfire of Meskel recalls, by tradition, the queen who followed the smoke and found the True Cross. Who? — Queen Eleni (Saint Helena, mother of Constantine).

text: አንድን ሰው «ሆደ ሰፊ ነው» ብንለው ምን ማለታችን ነው?
gloss: If we call someone "wide-bellied" (hode sefi), what do we mean? — That they are patient and tolerant. "Eats a lot" is the literal-reading trap.

text: በፔሩ ተራሮች ላይ የምትገኘውን ጥንታዊቷን ከተማ ማቹ ፒቹን የገነቡት እነማን ናቸው?
gloss: Who built the ancient mountain city of Machu Picchu in Peru? — The Incas. Aztecs, Maya and Olmecs were Mesoamerican, far to the north.

text: እያንዳንዱ ፎቶ 2 ሜጋባይት ቢሆን፣ 4 ጊጋባይት በሆነ ፍላሽ ላይ በግምት ስንት ፎቶ ይበቃል?
gloss: If each photo is 2 MB, about how many fit on a 4 GB flash drive? — About 2,000: a gigabyte is about 1,000 megabytes, so 4,000 ÷ 2.

text: በባህላዊው «አቡጊዳ» ንባብ ፊደላት በጥንቱ ቅደም ተከተል (አ፣ በ፣ ገ፣ ደ፣ ሀ…) እየመጡ በየተራ አንድ ዘር ከፍ ብለው ይነበባሉ፤ አ፣ ቡ፣ ጊ፣ ዳ። አምስተኛው ፊደል ሀ እንዴት ይነበባል?
gloss: In the traditional abugida recitation, letters come in the old order (A, B, G, D, H…) and each is read one vowel order higher: a, bu, gi, da. How is the fifth letter, ሀ, read? — ሄ (he), the 5th order. The chant goes «አ ቡ ጊ ዳ ሄ ው ዞ», and it gave linguists the word "abugida".

text: ከጣና ሐይቅ የሚነሳው ዓባይ ወንዝ ከነጭ ዓባይ ጋር የሚቀላቀለው በየትኛው ከተማ ነው?
gloss: In which city does the Blue Nile (Abay), which leaves Lake Tana, meet the White Nile? — Khartoum.

text: ኃይሌ ገብረሥላሴ የመጀመሪያውን የኦሊምፒክ የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ በ10,000 ሜትር ያገኘው በየትኛው ከተማ በተካሄደው ውድድር ነው?
gloss: In which host city did Haile Gebrselassie win his first Olympic gold in the 10,000 m? — Atlanta (1996). Sydney (2000) was his second gold.

text: መብረቁን ካዩ ከ3 ሰከንድ በኋላ ነጎድጓዱን ቢሰሙ፣ መብረቁ ከእርስዎ በግምት ምን ያህል ይርቃል?
gloss: You see lightning and hear the thunder 3 seconds later. Roughly how far away is it? — About 1 km: light arrives almost instantly, sound travels about 340 m per second.

text: በደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ ለብዙዎች ዋና ምግብ የሆነው ቆጮ የሚዘጋጀው ከየትኛው ተክል ነው?
gloss: Kocho, a staple for many in southern Ethiopia, is made from which plant? — Enset ("false banana"). Banana is the look-alike trap.

text: የኢትዮጵያን ቅኝቶች ከጃዝ ጋር አዋሕዶ «የኢትዮ-ጃዝ አባት» የተባለው ሙዚቀኛ ማን ነው?
gloss: Which musician blended Ethiopian modes (qenyet) with jazz and is called "the father of Ethio-jazz"? — Mulatu Astatke.

text: «ዘ ላየን ኪንግ» በተሰኘው የካርቱን ፊልም ውስጥ የሚዘመረው «ሀኩና ማታታ» ከየትኛው ቋንቋ የተወሰደ ነው?
gloss: "Hakuna Matata" from The Lion King comes from which language? — Swahili ("no worries"). Zulu is tempting because the film's opening chant is in Zulu.

text: ከእነዚህ ታሪካዊ ክስተቶች ቀድሞ የተፈጸመው የትኛው ነው?
options: ኮፐርኒከስ ስለ ፀሐይ ማዕከልነት የጻፈውን መጽሐፍ ማሳተሙ
ጉተንበርግ መጽሐፍ ቅዱስን በማተሚያ መሣሪያ ማተሙ
gloss: Which of these happened first? — Gutenberg printing the Bible (c. 1455). Columbus reached America in 1492, Luther issued his 95 Theses in 1517, Copernicus published in 1543. Reasoning helps: Luther's and Copernicus's texts spread by print.

text: እናት 30 ዓመቷ፣ ልጇ ደግሞ 6 ዓመቱ ነው። ከስንት ዓመት በኋላ የእናትየው ዕድሜ የልጇን ዕድሜ በትክክል ሦስት እጥፍ ይሆናል?
gloss: A mother is 30 and her child 6. In how many years will she be exactly three times the child's age? — 6 years: 36 = 3 × 12.

text: «በከዋክብት የተሞላው ምሽት» (ዘ ስታሪ ናይት) የተባለውን ዝነኛ ሥዕል የሣለው ማን ነው?
gloss: Who painted the famous "The Starry Night"? — Vincent van Gogh (1889). Gauguin, his friend, and the other post-/impressionists are the same-era traps.

text: በ1992 (እ.ኤ.አ.) የባርሴሎና ኦሊምፒክ በ10,000 ሜትር አሸንፋ ለኢትዮጵያ የኦሊምፒክ ወርቅ ያስገኘች የመጀመሪያዋ ሴት አትሌት ማን ናት?
gloss: Who won the 10,000 m at Barcelona 1992, becoming the first Ethiopian woman Olympic champion? — Derartu Tulu. Fatuma Roba won the marathon in 1996; Dibaba and Defar came later.

text: የአፍሪካ ሥነ ጽሑፍ ምልክት የሆነውን «ቲንግስ ፎል አፓርት» የተሰኘውን ልብ ወለድ የጻፈው ማን ነው?
gloss: Who wrote "Things Fall Apart", a landmark of African literature? — Chinua Achebe (1958). Soyinka and Okri are also Nigerian, Ngũgĩ Kenyan.

text: በ4ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ክርስትናን የተቀበለውና በሳንቲሞቹ ላይ መስቀል ያሳተመው የአክሱም ንጉሥ ማን ነው?
gloss: Which 4th-century king of Aksum accepted Christianity and put the cross on his coins? — Ezana. Kaleb and his son Gebre Meskel ruled in the 6th century; Ella Amida was Ezana's father.

text: አዲስ አበባ ከባሕር ወለል በላይ 2,300 ሜትር ገደማ ከፍታ ላይ ትገኛለች። እዚህ ክፍት ድስት ውስጥ ያለ ውሃ በግምት በስንት ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ ይፈላል?
gloss: Addis Ababa is about 2,300 m above sea level. At about what temperature does water boil there in an open pot? — About 92 °C: lower air pressure at altitude lowers the boiling point (roughly 1 °C per 300 m). 105 °C moves the wrong way; 80 °C is far too low.

text: ቀይ ባሕርን ከኤደን ባሕረ ሰላጤ ጋር የሚያገናኘው ጠባብ የባሕር ወሽመጥ ምን ይባላል?
gloss: What is the narrow strait linking the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden called? — Bab-el-Mandeb, between Djibouti and Yemen.

text: ሮማውያን በፀሐይ ዙሪያ በጣም በፍጥነት የምትዞረውን ፕላኔት በፈጣኑ መልእክተኛ አምላካቸው (የግሪኮቹ ሄርሜስ) ስም ሰየሟት። የትኛዋ ፕላኔት ናት?
gloss: The Romans named the planet that circles the Sun fastest after their swift messenger god (the Greeks' Hermes). Which planet? — Mercury. Know the god, or reason that the innermost planet orbits fastest.

text: በስዊዘርላንድ በሚገኝ የምርምር ማዕከል ሲሠራ ዓለም አቀፍ ድርን (ወርልድ ዋይድ ዌብ) የፈጠረው ሳይንቲስት ማን ነው?
gloss: Which scientist invented the World Wide Web while working at a research centre in Switzerland? — Tim Berners-Lee, at CERN. Vint Cerf is the trap: he co-designed the internet's TCP/IP, not the Web.

text: ላይ ላዩን አንድ ትርጉም፣ ውስጥ ደግሞ የተደበቀ ሁለተኛ ትርጉም ያለው የአማርኛ ቅኔ አገጣጠም «ሰምና …» ይባላል። የጎደለው ቃል የትኛው ነው?
gloss: The Amharic poetic device with a surface meaning and a hidden second one is called "wax and …"? — Gold (ሰምና ወርቅ), from lost-wax casting: the wax mould is the surface, the gold is the hidden meaning. "Wax and honey" is the trap.

text: ደሙ ሰማያዊ የሆነው ኦክቶፐስ ስንት ልብ አለው?
gloss: The blue-blooded octopus has how many hearts? — Three: two pump blood through the gills, one through the body.

text: የግዕዝ ቁጥሮች ዜሮ የላቸውም፤ ለምሳሌ ፻ 100 ሲሆን ፲፻ ደግሞ 1000 ነው። 2018 በግዕዝ ቁጥር እንዴት ይጻፋል?
gloss: Ge'ez numerals have no zero: ፻ is 100 and ፲፻ (ten hundreds) is 1000. How is 2018 written? — ፳፻፲፰: twenty (፳) hundreds (፻) plus ten (፲) and eight (፰). ፪፻፲፰ is 218, ፲፰፻፳ is 1820, ፳፻፹ is 2080.

text: ቅዱስ ያሬድ የደረሳቸው ዜማዎች በሦስት ስልቶች ይከፈላሉ፤ ግዕዝ፣ ዕዝል እና አንድ ሌላ። ሦስተኛው ስልት ምን ይባላል?
gloss: The chants of Saint Yared fall into three modes: Ge'ez, Ezel and one more. What is the third called? — Araray. Qene (poetry), wereb (a chant form) and mahlet (a night chant service) are church-music terms, but not modes.

text: የፀሐይ ብርሃን ምድር ለመድረስ 8 ደቂቃ ገደማ ይወስድበታል። ከጨረቃ የተንፀባረቀ ብርሃን ደግሞ ምድር ለመድረስ በግምት ምን ያህል ጊዜ ይወስድበታል?
gloss: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth. How long does light reflected from the Moon take? — Just over a second (about 1.3 s): the Moon is about 384,000 km away and light travels about 300,000 km per second (the Sun is roughly 400 times farther).

text: የአፍሪካ ዝቅተኛው ቦታ ከባሕር ወለል በታች 150 ሜትር ገደማ የሚገኝ የጨው ሐይቅ ነው። ይህ ሐይቅ በየትኛው አገር ይገኛል?
gloss: Africa's lowest point is a salt lake about 150 m below sea level. Which country is it in? — Djibouti (Lake Assal, about −155 m). Ethiopia's Danakil (about −125 m) and Egypt's Qattara Depression (about −133 m) are the near-miss traps.

text: «ከአድማስ ባሻገር» የተሰኘውን ልብ ወለድ የጻፈው ደራሲ ማን ነው?
gloss: Who wrote the novel "Beyond the Horizon" (Kadmas Bashager)? — Be'alu Girma (1970), also author of "Oromay". The others are fellow Amharic novelists of the period.

text: በአማርኛ «ቀይ ቀበሮ» እየተባለ የሚጠራው የኢትዮጵያ ተኩላ በብዛት የሚገኘው በየትኛው ብሔራዊ ፓርክ ነው?
gloss: In which national park does the Ethiopian wolf, called "red fox" in Amharic, live in the largest numbers? — Bale Mountains, home to the biggest population. The Simien Mountains have a smaller one; Awash and Nech Sar are lowland parks without it.

text: ኮምፒውተሮች በሚጠቀሙበት ባለ ሁለት አሃዝ (ባይናሪ) የቁጥር አጻጻፍ 1111 የሚወክለው የትኛውን ቁጥር ነው?
gloss: In the binary notation computers use, what number does 1111 stand for? — 15: 8 + 4 + 2 + 1. 16 is the trap (10000 in binary).

text: ላሊበላ «ሁለተኛዋ ኢየሩሳሌም» እንድትሆን ታስቦ እንደተቀረጸች ይነገራል፤ አብያተ ክርስቲያናቱን በሁለት ቡድን የሚከፍለው ጅረትም የቅድስት ምድርን ወንዝ ስም ይዟል። ስሙ ምንድን ነው?
gloss: Lalibela is said to have been carved as a "second Jerusalem", and the stream dividing its churches into two groups bears the name of a Holy Land river. What is it? — Yordanos (Jordan). Gihon is the trap: a biblical river Ethiopians link to the Abay, but not the Holy Land's.

text: የሮዜታ ድንጋይ አንድን አዋጅ በሦስት ዓይነት ጽሕፈት ይዟል፤ በሂሮግሊፍ፣ በዲሞቲክ እና በሌላ አንድ። ሦስተኛው የትኛው ነው?
gloss: The Rosetta Stone carries one decree in three scripts: hieroglyphic, demotic and one more. Which? — Ancient Greek, which is what let scholars decipher the hieroglyphs.

text: የዋልት ዲዝኒ ስቱዲዮ የመጀመሪያው ሙሉ ርዝመት ያለው የአኒሜሽን ፊልም የትኛው ነው?
gloss: What was Walt Disney studio's first feature-length animated film? — Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937). Pinocchio (1940), Bambi (1942) and Cinderella (1950) followed.

text: በስፔኗ ቢልባኦ ከተማ የሚገኘውን፣ በብረት ልባስ የተሸፈነውን የጉገንሃይም ሙዚየም የነደፈው አርክቴክት ማን ነው?
gloss: Which architect designed the metal-clad Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao, Spain? — Frank Gehry (1997, titanium cladding). The others are star architects of the same generation.
